def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    srcs=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    src=srcs[0]
    fill=3
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for j in range(w):
        s=[i for i in range(h) if g[i][j]==src]
        for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
            for i in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=fill
    for i in range(h):
        s=[j for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==src]
        for a,b in zip(s,s[1:]):
            for j in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=fill
    return out

import json,re,os
# reload all demos
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
